description: Karnataka's 2025 reforms bill aims to integrate AI in district judiciary, enhancing efficiency while establishing fast track courts for timely case resolution.
body_lead: As the use of artificial intelligence (AI) spreads across sectors, the Karnataka government is coming up with a legislation to allow use of AI to streamline the justice delivery system in the district judiciary. This is expected to enhance speed, accuracy, transparency, accessibility and objectivity in judicial process. The implementation of AI will be a coordinated effort between the State government and the Karnataka High Court under the proposed “Karnataka District Judiciary Reforms Bill, 2025”, which covers other aspects of judiciary reforms too.
